purpose.zh: 在完整幅度里加强伸肘力量
purpose.en: Build elbow-straightening strength through a full range.

text.zh: 下放到上臂约与地面平行即可
text.en: Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor

text.zh: 顶端肘锁直、肩下压，停1秒
text.en: Lock your elbows and press your shoulders down at the top for one second.

text.zh: 屈膝收腿，不要摆腿借力
text.en: Keep your knees bent and do not swing your legs.

commonErrors.en: Going too deep and letting the shoulders sink forward.

cautions.zh: 肩部不适者先做顶端支撑停留；下放深度控制在不痛的范围
cautions.en: If your shoulders feel uncomfortable, start with top holds and only lower as far as is pain-free.
